pages.title: Frozen Fever Olaf Leading Mischievous Snowgies Through an Arendelle Castle Corridor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page from Frozen Fever shows Olaf leading mischievous Snowgies along an Arendelle castle corridor with pointed arches and candle sconces. Olaf spreads his twig arms and lifts one foot, while the smaller snow creatures follow around him. The coloring sheet combines round character shapes with narrow wall panels and a snowflake floor motif.

pages.title: Frozen Marshmallow Guarding the Entrance to Elsa's Ice Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: Marshmallow fills this printable coloring page from Frozen, guarding the entrance to Elsa's ice palace with an open mouth, angular teeth, and a reaching hand. Jagged ice spikes cover his shoulders, arms, and feet beneath the towering pointed doorway. This coloring sheet pairs large body sections with smaller crystal facets and long, narrow palace details.

pages.title: Frozen Sven Eating a Carrot in the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Sven from Frozen stands in the snow with a leafy carrot in his mouth and wide antlers above his head. His shaggy chest and tufted legs contrast with the smooth curves of his muzzle. The coloring sheet leaves broad spaces across his body and the snowy hills, with smaller pine trees in the distance.

pages.title: Frozen Kristoff Holding the Reins as Sven Pulls His Ice-laden Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page from Frozen, Kristoff holds the reins as Sven pulls a sleigh stacked with ice blocks past snowy pines and mountains. Sven wears a harness with small bells, and the sleigh has curved runners and plank sides. These details add smaller sections to a coloring sheet with open sky and snow around the travelers.

pages.title: Frozen 2 Kristoff Proposing to Anna in the Enchanted Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page from Frozen 2, Kristoff kneels with an open ring box while Anna clasps her hands in the Enchanted Forest. Tree trunks frame the pair, and fallen leaves lie around their boots. The coloring sheet includes broad clothing panels alongside the ring, Anna's cape border, and small leaves overhead.

pages.title: Frozen Anna Riding Sven While Kristoff Leads Them Through the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: Anna rides Sven while Kristoff leads them through the snow on this printable coloring page from Frozen, with evergreen trees rising behind the three characters. Anna's braids, patterned skirt, and cape border add small details above Sven's broad body. The coloring sheet also includes Kristoff's mittens, the lead rope, and curved snowbanks beneath their feet.

pages.title: Frozen Young Kristoff Cutting Blocks of Ice on a Mountain Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Kristoff from Frozen sawing a block of ice on a mountain lake, surrounded by snowy peaks and scattered pines. His mittened hands grip the large saw above the rectangular blocks. Broad ice faces and clothing sections give the coloring sheet open areas, while the saw teeth and fur trim provide finer edges.

pages.title: Frozen Fever Snowgies Sitting on Marshmallow's Shoulders Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page from Frozen Fever shows Snowgies sitting on Marshmallow's shoulders, with another snow creature perched on his head above his broad smile. Marshmallow holds his large hands in front of him, their edges studded with angular ice shapes. The coloring sheet has a blank background and generous spaces across the characters' rounded bodies.

pages.title: Frozen Oaken Waving From Behind the Counter of His Trading Post Coloring Page
pages.description: Oaken waves from behind his trading post counter in this printable coloring page from Frozen, wearing a patterned sweater, suspenders, and a pom-pom hat. Shelves behind him hold rolled rugs, bottles, a small chest, and other shop supplies. The coloring sheet includes many small geometric clothing patterns alongside the broad boards of the counter.

pages.title: Frozen Duke of Weselton Dancing in the Arendelle Ballroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Duke of Weselton dancing in the Arendelle ballroom, with one foot lifted and both hands held away from his sides. His round glasses, curled mustache, medals, and fringed shoulder decorations add distinctive details. Curtains, a column, and patterned wall panels frame the figure on this Frozen coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen 2 Bruni Resting on a Leaf with His Tail Curled Beside Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Bruni rests on a large leaf with his tail curled beside him in this printable coloring page from Frozen 2, looking upward with oversized eyes. Two smaller leaves surround the salamander, with clear veins inside each outline. The coloring sheet uses bold contours and broad body areas, with smaller sections around the toes and leaf veins.

pages.title: Frozen 2 Nokk Emerging From a Curling Ocean Wave Coloring Page
pages.description: Nokk emerges from a curling ocean wave in this printable coloring page from Frozen 2, with raised front legs and a mane drawn as flowing water. An arching crest frames the horse while droplets and splashes surround the hooves. The coloring sheet combines broad body areas with long mane strands and many smaller shapes in the surf.

pages.title: Frozen 2 Earth Giant Standing Beside the River in the Enchanted Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Frozen 2 Earth Giant standing beside a river in the Enchanted Forest, with massive rock hands and rounded shoulders. Large stone sections divide his body into broad coloring areas, while the winding river, scattered boulders, and small trees add finer landscape details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen 2 Lieutenant Mattias Greeting Anna Beneath the Forest Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: Lieutenant Mattias greets Anna beneath the forest trees in this printable coloring page from Frozen 2, with one hand resting against his uniformed chest. Anna raises a hand beside him, wearing a long coat and patterned boots. Leafy branches frame the coloring sheet, with smaller sections in his shoulder fringe, her clothing borders, and the fallen leaves.

pages.title: Elsa from Frozen Smiling with a Side Braid Coloring Page
Frozen Characters in Earth Giant Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Frozen valley scene with a crowned princess holding a crystal-tipped staff beside an enormous, bearded rock giant. Trees, shrubs, and scattered stones cover parts of the giant's body, with mountains and a winding river behind them. The coloring sheet combines broad gown panels with small snowflake motifs and leafy details.

pages.title: Frozen Characters in Icy Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a crowned girl in a Frozen icy canyon, wearing twin braids, a patterned cape, and decorated boots between towering cliffs. Long icicles hang above her, and a waterfall descends in the background. Broad cape and skirt sections contrast with the narrow cliff lines and small snowflakes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen Characters in Snowy Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A braided girl stands among snowy fir trees in this printable coloring page from Frozen, wearing earmuffs, mittens, and a cape patterned with leaves and snowflakes. Falling snow dots the open sky above rounded snowbanks and bare shrubs. This coloring sheet offers broad skirt and tree sections around the smaller cape motifs, belt, and braid segments.

pages.title: Frozen Characters in Misty Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents a Frozen forest portrait of a braided girl wearing earmuffs, mittens, and a cape edged with fluffy trim. Snowflake shapes decorate her braid, while curved leaf motifs border the cape and bodice. Lightly drawn trees and bare branches frame the coloring sheet, leaving generous open areas around the central portrait.

pages.title: Frozen Characters in Royal Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: A Frozen queen sits on an ornate throne in this printable coloring page, holding a snowflake-topped scepter and wearing a crown above her side braid. Snowflake carvings, scrolls, and diamond shapes decorate the high-backed seat. Large gown panels balance the smaller jewelry, scepter details, and window decorations throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen Characters in Forest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page brings Elsa, Olaf, and Sven together in a snowy forest clearing, with Elsa's long gown centered between the snowman and reindeer. Olaf raises his twig arms, and Sven's branching antlers extend above her shoulder. Simple fir trees and large falling snowflakes surround the broad, open character shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Queen Anna Arendelle Coloring Page
Young Anna Making Snow Magic Near an Ice Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: Anna makes snow magic near an ice palace in this printable coloring page from Frozen, extending both hands beneath curling ribbons of magic and floating snowflakes. Her twin braids and wide skirt sit before a tall palace with pointed towers. This coloring sheet pairs broad clothing and sky areas with smaller snowflakes, spiral lines, and angular palace sections.

pages.title: Frozen Anna Running In A Magical Ice Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Anna running through a magical ice kingdom from Frozen, with her long cape and twin braids streaming behind her. Crystal clusters line the snowy path, with fir trees and tall palace spires in the background. Broad dress panels and snowbanks give the coloring sheet open spaces between the smaller geometric details.

pages.title: Frozen Queen Jumping Near A Snowy Path Coloring Page
pages.description: A crowned Frozen queen jumps above a snowy path in this printable coloring page, spreading both hands as her long hair and cape sweep sideways. Large snowflakes surround her above simple fir trees and distant hills. The coloring sheet has open skirt, cape, and snowbank sections, with smaller details in the crown and scalloped dress hem.

Frozen Sven Making Ice Magic Inside the Ice Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Sven makes ice magic inside an ice castle in this printable coloring page from Frozen, lifting one hoof beneath swirling snowflakes, sparkles, and pointed crystal shapes. His large antlers and shaggy chest fill the center, with icicles and arched walls behind him. This coloring sheet combines broad body sections with small harness studs and angular ice details.
